accepted_plan.summary: Introduce explicit `WorkerFilesystemAuthority` with `None` and `Local(LocalWorkingDirectory)` variants, remove Worker-level `cwd` field/accessor, gate core filesystem tools/Bash on local filesystem authority, and update constructor/restore/embedded/spawn paths plus tests so no-workdir Workers have no filesystem tool surface or cwd fallback.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator accepts queued Ticket after inspecting current Ticket, relations, orchestration plan, inprogress queue, and clean orchestration worktree. Use sibling Coder for implementation in a dedicated worktree, then sibling Reviewer for read-only review. Orchestrator retains merge/final-validation/close/cleanup authority.
